purpose: Expose contextual actions and optional menu checkbox/radio preferences, grouped items and nested submenus.
anatomy: optional submenu triggers and nested popups
behaviorProvider: Base UI Menu primitives with typed recursive menu entries and optional DirectionProvider.

component: Menu entry composition and primitive navigation/dismissal delegation
Checkbox/radio selection requests and per-item close policy
Trigger composition, disabled items and popup naming
host: Meaningful labels, stable identities and any actual shortcuts

requirements.statement: Forward open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange to the Menu root. Default defaultOpen and modal to false; modal is independently configurable.

Compose the supplied element through Primitive.Trigger. Treat native button elements and custom components as native-button triggers; non-button intrinsic elements use the primitive non-native trigger path.
Render the discriminated entry types as primitive action items, checkbox items, radio groups, submenus, groups or separators. Groups and submenus recursively render their supplied items.

Keep keyboard navigation, typeahead, submenu navigation, Escape dismissal and focus return delegated to Base UI Menu; this wrapper does not replace the menu with a form select or a custom key handler.

Forward an action item onSelect as the primitive Item onClick handler and leave normal action-item closing to the primitive default. intent destroy selects visual treatment; it does not add a confirmation or permission check.

Render checkbox menu items without closing on click. Map indeterminate to aria-checked mixed and a minus indicator, and convert its next activation callback to true; otherwise forward the primitive boolean next value.
Render each radio-group from its supplied value and onValueChange, with individual disabled options and closeOnClick enabled on radio items.
Pass disabled flags to action items, checkbox items, radio options and submenu triggers. A group label or separator is structural rather than an action.

Name the top-level popup from label, default Actions, and render item labels, optional icons and shortcut hints. Apply DirectionProvider only when an explicit dir is supplied; otherwise inherit surrounding direction.

Update open when controlled and update checkbox checked/radio value when accepting callbacks. Supply unique stable entry ids and radio option values; the menu does not store application preferences for controlled entries.

Provide a named operable trigger and meaningful menu/item labels, implement every advertised action and any shortcut key handling, and own destructive-action confirmation or errors. shortcut text is a kbd display only, not a registered command.
Use the trigger group for DropdownMenu-owned styling and icon defaults, including portaled menus and submenus. Preserve Base UI focus/navigation behavior and nested shared component ownership.

limitations: This is an action/menu-preference surface, not a form-compatible single-value Select. It has no public name/form/required/readOnly field API.
Displayed shortcuts and destructive intent are presentation, not shortcut registration, authorization or confirmation behavior.
The current family stories demonstrate states and local callbacks but contain no play assertions; no passing interaction evidence is claimed by this baseline.
Controlled checkbox/radio item state remains with the host, and indeterminate is not a user-cycled third state.
